title: TileHeader
description: Header (web/public/data/tiles/{region}_{res}m.json) for a raw terrain height tile handed from the pipeline to the engine's mask builder. The binary is nx * ny little-endian float32 heights, row-major; file length is nx * ny * 4 bytes. Axis and index convention: see x0.

region.description: Region id (no units); the file name is {region}_{res}m.

dtype.description: Element type of the binary (no units): IEEE 754 binary32, little-endian.

units.description: Unit of the stored heights: metres.

nodata.description: Stored value in metres that marks a missing cell, or null when every cell is valid.

height_reference_radius_m.description: Radius in metres of the sphere the heights are measured from; a cell's distance from the Moon's centre is this plus its height.
